title: Aptitude Test and Career Guidance 2
summary: As part of RCBA’s Aptitude Test and Career Guidance initiative, supported by the HRI Foundation, 49 students from Smt. MGS English High School participated in a three-stage programme conducted by VITAMELIORA LLP.
description: As part of RCBA’s Aptitude Test and Career Guidance initiative, supported by the HRI Foundation, 49 students from Smt. MGS English High School participated in a three-stage programme conducted by VITAMELIORA LLP. The programme began with an orientation on 3 September 2026, followed by a written aptitude test on 27 September 2026. On 13 October 2026, Mr Himanshu Dave and Ms Tejal Dave conducted one-on-one discussions of the test reports with students and their parents. The initiative aims to help students understand their aptitude and potential, explore suitable courses and college options, and make informed career choices.
location: Smt. MGS English High School, Mumbai, Maharashtra
